text:
zoe: hi folks, first day! my Okta invite fails with "user not found" when I try to accept (zoe@redwood.ai). 1Password won't let me finish and the Onboarding drive is empty. yubikey shows as shipped but delayed. who can reprovision or give a temp access path?
maria-peopleops: hey @zoe  sorry about that. looks like your Okta entry created with a dot-alias (zoe.j@). i'm re-linking your primary email and re-sending the invite now. i'll also request a 1Password seat.
infra-bot: ticket ONB-9001 created for Okta email mismatch and 1Password seat. assigned to people-ops. ETA 30m.
ben-eng: if you need repo access sooner we can add your SSH key to GitHub org. DM me the pubkey. for secrets, we can give a temporary vault share for 24h. want that?
zoe: yes please to both (temp vault + ssh). can you DM instructions for the SSH key gen?
ben-eng: sure. quick gen:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "zoe@redwood.ai"
# paste ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub into a DM
```
maria-peopleops: invite resent at 2551239892 (subject: "Redwood Okta Invite"). yubikey ETA 3 business days. temporary passkey allowed until hardware arrives  enable under Okta -> Security after sign-in.
zoe: i clicked the new link and it asked me to approve a device, then hit an error "account not linked". 1Password still shows "account not provisioned".
infra-bot: automation note: re-provision step retried by people-ops worker at 2551239905.
maria-peopleops: seat added. try `op signin` again in ~2 minutes. if it still errors i'll DM a rotated temp password (expires 6h).
zoe: `op signin` worked! team vault visible and onboarding folder has files. sent SSH pubkey via DM. repo clone succeeded. thanks everyone.
it-bot: ONB-9001 resolved by people-ops at 2551239930.
maria-peopleops: welcome to Redwood, @zoe :tada: i'll follow up with yubikey tracking and add you to #eng-general and onboarding docs. ping here if anything else pops up.
